brand.name: BlueStone
brand.summary: BlueStone is one of India's largest e-commerce portals for fine jewellery, founded in 2011 by Gaurav Singh Kushwaha in Bangalore. Offering over 7,000 certified contemporary designs in gold, diamond, platinum, and gemstones, BlueStone provides a seamless omnichannel shopping experience through its website, mobile app, and numerous physical retail stores across India.

competitor_analysis.brand_overview: BlueStone operates in the highly competitive Indian fine jewellery market, differentiating itself through an omnichannel model, 7000+ certified designs, a lifetime exchange and buyback policy, and innovative upgrades like the Big Gold Upgrade.
